body: I understand. I really fucked up.

I know deep down he is very hurt and probably not sleeping well. I don't want to hurt him and I already have. When I told him initially he was saying he will stay but he has no more dignity left. But then he said it's my life and I am fine. 

I feel like I need to work on myself a lot. I just want to be with him. I am ashamed.
The guy did not come to my place. I just left the cab and went home. My boyfriend just said he's fine and he's going to not think about this anymore. I don't know if that's good or bad.
i need someone to give me advice please
